title: A positive quadratic Gaussian-tail gain survives exponentially small exact partition repair

statement.quantifiers: Fixed0<rho<1, planar equal-measure three parallel Gaussian slabs, epsilon→0+.
statement.assertion: Rotating both outward normals toward the same side gives stability gain4rho phi2(a,a;−rho)epsilon²+O_rho(epsilon⁴); repairing overlap of measure at most exp[−a²/(2sin²epsilon)] restores exact balance without cancelling the gain.
assumptions: a=Phi^-1(2/3)>0; Gaussian nonatomicity allows exact equal-measure repair.
Bivariate upper-tail derivative in correlation is the positive joint density.
Noise-functional L1 change is bounded by a constant times changed measure; formal middle indicator need not be a partition before repair.

inputs: Exact outer halfspaces and fixed positive Gaussian correlation.
outputs: Arbitrarily small measure-preserving perturbations strictly improve slabs, without solving global optimality.
interface.precision: Fixed-rho analytic O_rho bounds; no uniform joint correlation/perturbation endpoint threshold provided.
costs: No numerical code, exact finite diagnostic or executable subset-selection compiler supplied.
Historical priority and imported identity source locators unresolved.

proof_mechanism: Each rotated outer halfspace retains mass1/3 by rotational invariance.
Expand the formal three-label quadratic functional; the only changing cross-tail has correlation−rho cos2epsilon.
Differentiate that tail to get a strictly positive quadratic leading gain.
Overlap forces vertical coordinate>a/sin epsilon, giving an exponentially small Gaussian tail.
Remove overlap from one outer cell and add equal measure from the remaining middle region; bounded L1 effect is negligible relative to epsilon².
obstructions: Formal overlapping halfspaces alone are not an admissible partition.
The fixed-rho gain does not imply a uniform rho→0/1 theorem with one epsilon schedule.
Slab instability does not eliminate curved competitors or force propeller optimality.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Identify a positive leading gain and a genuine repair whose functional effect is of smaller order; charge any effective selection/precision claims.
